name: TMade Alex
streamSlot: Mon–Fri · NY AM from ~9:00 AM, lunch box 12–1 PM, Asia from 8:00 PM ET
tagline: NQ scalper who went from ICT to volume profile and order flow — value tells him where, an inversion tells him when, and his session 'boxes' tell him what time.
summary: TMade Alex is a New York–based NQ futures scalper and founder of the TraderMade (TMADE) community, who trades a copy-traded stack of prop-firm and Vest perps accounts and streams the New York, lunch and Asia sessions live. A former ICT and initial-balance trader and longtime PropFirmMatch co-host (the lunch-box slot), he now builds context from weekly and session volume profiles, delta and dealer gamma levels, and uses ICT inversion FVGs only as the entry trigger. He trades named session ranges — the Bento, Sushi, Breakfast and Lunch boxes — sizes evals aggressively and funded accounts small (micros), and takes base hits and frequent payouts.
oneLiner: Read weekly and session value with the volume profile, wait for aggression to fail at a value edge or box level, enter on an inversion with the big orders, and take the rotation to VWAP/POC — small size, base hits, breakeven fast.
keyQuote: Volume profile confirms it. Now the trigger is the inversion fair value gap.
highlights: Never short into a weekly value area low or long into a weekly value area high
If price can't hold above value, trade the rotation to the other side of value
Volume profile is the context; a 1- or 5-minute inversion FVG is the trigger
Sushi box sweeps the Bento range → trade back to Bento VWAP; lunch box retraces to 50% and VWAP
Evals: risk 50–100% to pass fast; funded: 25% per trade, 1–5 micros
Don't trade the open — the 10, 11 and 2 o'clock hours carry the probability

articles.title: TRADERMADE — Whop community page
articles.takeaway: "Transparency. Accountability. Results." A futures day-trading community built on live sessions Monday–Friday; free Discord tier (~1.1K members) and a paid plan; 5.0 from 18 reviews — members single out his trade-by-trade explanations and his lunch-session trading.

profile.style: intraday NQ scalping — volume profile/order flow context with ICT inversion entries
profile.niche: named session 'boxes' (Bento, Sushi, Breakfast, Lunch) + weekly value rotations, traded on copy-traded prop and perps stacks

sources.notes: 79 channel streams catalogued; 39 transcripts read (~1.18M words: 30 own streams, 5 PropFirmMatch co-hosted streams, 2 PFM 12-hour streams at the lunch slot, 2 shorts), distilled with timestamps; Whop community page; researched 2026-11-18. Many streams are co-hosted (Zarb/Zach, Druby, others) — only Alex's own statements are used. Profit figures are his own on-stream claims.
